# 00000004227

**HT2-17 ★** — source: 126_组合代数拓扑_高阶树.md

**English.** Definition: A flag complex is the simplicial complex generated by the cliques of a graph. Conjecture: The 2-tree count of a flag complex is given by explicit evaluations of the chromatic polynomial of the graph at negative integers, with conversion constant 1 and evaluation points the clique number minus 2. (flag 2-tree chromatic polynomial conversion)

**中文。** 定义：旗复形指由图的团生成的单形复形。猜想：旗复形的 2-树计数由图的色多项式在负整数处的显式求值给出,转化常数为 1 且求值点为团数减 2。（旗 2-树-色多项式转化）
